crossRefs.note: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
“Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and…

translations.web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
translations.bsb: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
translations.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
translations.asv: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.
